params.body: The watcher moved its checker to v0.16.3 while the machine stayed on v0.16.2, and held RTMR3 to the wrong binary: the checker's own tag is not the reference. The records name the release the machine runs, with the sha256 the boot script installed it by. The checker now reads that from the newest record across the chains, fetches that asset, holds it to the named sha256, and RTMR3 to its SHA-384. --release-sha384 by hand and --offline stay. Whole asset read, not the first eight megabytes, which is what the first attempt did. verify-yourself.md simplified to --did-log and no download.
params.title: verify: the release from the records, its asset fetched and held to its sha256
